_film: 005497948 — Selce, 802 images. Several books on one film under DIFFERENT waypoints: image 200 is a «HISTORIA PAROCHIAE», images ~380-400+ are the LIBER DEFUNCTORUM, image 600 is a later Croatian-ruled death register.
_index_warning: The FamilySearch record index holds **baptisms only** for Selce — 119 indexed Antić entries, none of them deaths. The index-with-ARK shortcut does not work for this register; it has to be walked.
_how_to_get_an_ark: https://www.familysearch.org/en/search/film/005497948?i=<N-1> then read the ARK out of document.title. Each navigation wipes injected page scripts, so re-inject the tile reader after every move.
_year_map: NOT 2.7 images per year. Measured: 311 = 1834, 338 = early 1849, 339-340 = Sept-Oct 1850, 341 = 1851-52, 384 = 1877, 397 = 1882, 400 = 1883-84. That is about 1.7 images per year through the 1830s-50s and 2.7 through the 1870s-80s. Interpolate, then CHECK the printed page number and the year in TEMPUS MORTIS.

years.200: HISTORIA PAROCHIAE — parish history, not a register
years.384: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 118 — Aug to Nov 1877
years.397: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 144 — Feb to Jul 1882
years.400: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 150 — Nov 1883 into Feb 1884
years.311: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM — Jan to Jun 1834, in Latin, about four entries to a page
years.338: January to March 1849, now in CROATIAN («Godista 1849 na 9 Sečna»)
years.340: pages 98-99 — «mens. 8ber & 9ber 1850», 10 to 21 October 1850. THE CHOLERA PAGES: the remarks column reads «Od kolere» down the sheet.
years.341: pages 100-101 — Feb to Aug 1851 (left) and 1852 (right). Only about nine entries to the year: the epidemic is over.
years.342: a denser, older-looking section — the film is not strictly one book here
years.304: 1829 — left page 6 Feb to about June, right page 11 July to 6 September. BOTH 1829 ancestors are here.

_columns: TEMPUS MORTIS (year over day+month, Croatian month names) · Nrus Domus (village + house number) · NOMEN DEFUNCTI et Conditio · sex/status ticks · age in years · remarks, which carry the burial date.
_found_here: Ahnentafel 25 — «Udova Maria Antić, supruga pok. Josipa, kći Jurja i Mare Jeličić, R. Katolikinja», Selce house 29, aged 73, died 6 July 1882, buried 7 July. Image 397, entry 21, ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99X-1357.

Ahnentafel 24 — «Letta 850. na 21. 8bre · Nrus Domus 74 · Preminu Osip Antić težak i Mare kćer · 44 / 6 · Od kolere». Page 99, image 340, ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99X-13PY. One entry for father and six-year-old daughter. Age 44 agrees with the tree's birth of 14 Mar 1806. See notes/selce-cholera-1850.md.
A by-name — «Vincentius Jurich, aliter Loveranich», Selce house 58, died 21 March 1834 aged 55. Image 311, ark 3:1:3QS7-899X-1Q6X.
Ahnentafel 48 — «Die 13a Martii 1829 · Nrus Domus 51 · Joannes Antich Papa. obiit Annorum 64». Image 304, ark 3:1:3QS7-L99X-1QQL.

Ahnentafel 49 — «Die 15e Julii 1829 · Nrus Domus 56 · Margarita uxor Joannis Antich Natanchii obiit Annorum 52», Natanchii underlined. Image 304, same ark. Dates and ages match the tree exactly; the houses (51 vs 56) and the by-names (Papa vs Natanchii) do not agree, and that is left open. See notes/selce-antic-1829-papa.md.

_still_wanted._where: Measured density is about 1.7 images to the year through the 1830s-50s and the book runs BACK from 302 = 1828: 1811 lands near image 273, 1807 near 266, 1793 near 242. All three are far outside the measured range and the film changes books more than once — check the page heading, and read the printed page number before writing any negative.

_page_numbers: The printed page number sits in the TOP OUTER CORNER of each leaf and only the right-hand leaf carries it legibly: image 340's right leaf is 99, image 341's right leaf is 101, so the leaf between them is 100. Use this to prove a date gap is a real gap and not a missing page BEFORE writing any negative.
